name: Evidence Studio
description:
Evidence is an AI-powered BI tool for publishing reports using SQL and Markdown. This connector lets Claude work with your organization's live data and published reports on your behalf - securely, and scoped to your own permissions.

After you connect your Evidence account, Claude can:
- Browse table metadata
- Run read-only queries against data stored in Evidence
- Search your published reports by topic, metric, or term, and read a page's content or a structured summary of its queries and components
- Retrieve AI context stored in Evidence - so answers match how your organization reports

Requires an Evidence account with workspace access. 

Learn more at https://evidence.dev

_published_faq.name: How do I add Evidence Studio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Evidence Studio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://evidence.studio/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Evidence Studio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Evidence Studio provides these MCP tools: get_context, get_metadata, get_page_content, get_page_summary, list_organizations, list_project_pages, list_projects, list_tables, run_query, search_published_content, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Evidence Studio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Evidence Studio in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Evidence Studio MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Evidence Studio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Evidence Studio is developed by Evidence Technologies. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
